notes: variant WLC.1SA.24.18.v003 underdetermined; r00-base carried and compatible with the ASV

Corrected: *when* separated from the אֲשֶׁר unit and marked `added`. The clause holds one conjunction morpheme and the ASV writes two subordinators (*forasmuch as*, *when*); the surplus is the supplied temporal one, exactly as rule 45 leaves a *when* `added` before an asyndetic temporal clause whose apodosis waw the ASV leaves unrendered.
